teaser: Hacking Portugal, my 2016 BSidesLisbon keynote and the book at 95%: a Hacking Service, OpenSource.pt, a Ministry of Code, and what holds ten years on.
core_idea: The 2016 keynote and book argued Portugal should hack itself: a network hostile to insecure code, a Hacking Service for young people, a hackathon league, Code Made in Portugal, OpenSource.pt, a Ministry of Code and a Clear Software Act; ten years later Europe brought the regulation and Portugal open-sourced a national model, the service and league did not happen, and agents make the bet that a small country can lead in code more possible.
